posts.text: Our stats page now takes plain English. Type "ppg vs points against" and it builds all 32 teams, scored vs allowed. It knows the nicknames too: pick six, time of possession, total defense, bad hands. Find it under Stats, then Visualize, on our site. 🧵
Ask it a question. "Who gets the targets on Washington" gives you every Commander's target share. Stefon Diggs leads at 23.2%, Terry McLaurin is next at 17.9%.

The cupcake filter. "QBs vs cupcakes EPA per dropback" only counts games against bottom-half teams. Drake Maye (.628) and Brock Purdy (.624) are eating. Swap in "vs top half" to see who shows up against real teams.
Talk like a fan. "How often they blitz" finds blitz rate. Minnesota sends extra rushers on 71.5% of dropbacks and nobody else is above 47.4%. That's not a scheme, that's a lifestyle.

Then build it your way: bar, line, pie, scatter, radar or a table. Teams or players, per game or totals, any seasons or weeks, everyone or only top-half teams or cupcakes, the last few games, and filters like "sacks >= 3".

Style it too: your own title and subtitle, name the four corners, highlight up to 6 teams, 5 color schemes, logo size, logos and names on or off, rounded bars, bigger text. Is the NFC East any good? Not one of them made the Contenders corner.
Download it sized for an X post, a square or a phone story, on dark, light or see-through. Save it to My charts, copy the link or share it. College works too. Go win an argument.
